definition: GPT-5.1 is a family of five large language models within OpenAI's GPT series.
details: Three were released on November 12, 2025; two more were released one week later on November 19.

explainer.lead: GPT-5.1 is a family of five large language models in OpenAI's GPT series, rather than a single model. The family arrived in two batches one week apart, making the release dates useful when identifying its members.

tiers.eli5: It's a set of five AI models from the same family, with three arriving first and the other two following a week later.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers pick among the five models in the family depending on their needs rather than treating GPT-5.1 as one fixed model. A pitfall is assuming all five appeared at once: three were released on November 12, 2025, and the remaining two on November 19, 2025.
tiers.paperLevel: GPT-5.1 is defined as a family of five large language models belonging to OpenAI's GPT series, with three released on November 12, 2025 and two released on November 19, 2025. No further specification of the individual models is given.

flow: A prompt is given to one GPT-5.1 family member
The selected large language model processes the prompt
The model produces a language response
explainer.origin: OpenAI released three GPT-5.1 models on November 12, 2025. It released the remaining two on November 19, 2025.
explainer.lineage: GPT-5.1 belongs to OpenAI's GPT series. Its five members form a single model family released in two stages.
explainer.whyItMatters: The family structure prevents GPT-5.1 from being mistaken for one individual model. Its two release batches also provide a clear timeline for tracking the five members.

diagram.caption: The five-model GPT-5.1 family and its two release batches within OpenAI's GPT series.

explainer.example: A team targeting the newest GPT-5.1 members waits until November 19, 2025, when the second pair of models is released.
